rang ba// gnyis ka bsdoms nas ma rnams kyi// don du byang chub chen por bsngos// sems can che khyod ldan pa dang*// 'du dang rkyang pas 'tshe med cing*// bcu phrag brgya dang lnga yi lor// nges par 'tsho gyur zhes smon gdab// gang shar 'di kun rang gi sems// sems nyid gdod nas 'od gsal ba// rang rang lhag pa'i lhar bzhengs nas// 'jigs med mtha' bral chen por gzhog

/de nas de yi rjes thob tu// bram ze bzhin du gtsang ba dang*// pha bzhin kun la brtse ba dang*// dmigs bu bzhin du ldongs pa la// lam dang lam min dbye byos shig /ces pa'i mchid phrin spyan zung gi /lam du 'dren byed kha lo pa// rab mnyam bdud rtsi'i phur ma ni// zung ldan 'di yis dge gyur cig /ces chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes gsum la/ g.yas ru gtsang gis sa'i thig le/ thub bstan gser mdog can gyi dben gnas dam pa nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //chu mig rab 'byams pa ye shes dpal la gnang ba// ༄// drung rab 'byams pa'i phyag tu phul ba/ sku khams bzang zhing*/ bar chad med pa'i ngos nas/ nyams dang rtogs pa gong tu 'phel zhing*/ rang byung gi ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ gzhan byung mtshan ma'i sprin tshogs kyis ma sgribs par/ spros bral gyi nam mkha' la bde bar rgyu zhing*/ kun rdzob spros bcas kyi sa gzhi la/ 'khrul snang sgyu ma'i zhabs zung brtan par bzhugs lags sam/ 'dir yang*/ rnam dpyod dbang po'i lag pas gsal bar bris pa'i legs bshad 'ja' mtshon gyi ri mos/ blo gsal dri za'i na gzhon gyi kun dga' bskyed pa'i ngang tshul las ma g.yos bzhin du/ yum lha mo bzhi cha snyoms pa'i phang pa na/ sras rdo rje rnam gsum mtshar du dngar bar bzhugs mchis so// zhes pa'i 'phrin shog padma dkar po'i ge sar gyi rtse la/ spyan zung bung ba rnam gnyis 'khor zhing lding ba'i rol rtsed mi 'dor ba'i rten mtshon byed du/ dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'gram pa la gtar ba'i thigs pa zhig 'bul// ༈ //myang stod rab 'byams pa khams cung zhig ma bde ba'i tshe gnang ba// ༄// rab 'byams sangs rgyas lhun grub nas// chos dpal dge 'dun bzang po ba// gnyis med ye shes ma ltas par// gnyis snang 'khrul pa nyams la ni// mtshan mar bzung ba'i nga rgyal gyis// 'byung po'i bar chad skye srid pas// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms byas te// rang rig rang gsal rang zhal ltos// gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyis// 'brong po'i rwa rtse'i sgang nas springs// 'byung po 'dul byed kyi nyi ma la bris//

༈ //mnga' ris stod pa dpon btsun nam mkha' dpal 'byor la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ sde snod 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes// dpon btsun nam mkha' dpal 'byor gyis// yi ge kha ra'i rten bcas pa// bar chad med par 'dir thengs so// gang der slebs nas lus bde zhing*// sems la mya ngan med pa dang*// chos sgrub pa yi mthun rkyen yang*// tshang zhes thos pas blo ba spro// slar yang phrag dog bud shing la// zhe sdang me chen mi 'bar zhing*// gang na 'grogs na sems bde ba// 'ba' zhig skyed pa'i gnas su bzhugs// bstan pa'i rgyun la phan srid na// 'ga' zhig tsam gyi don byar rung*// chos min 'ba' zhig 'phel 'gyur na// gcig pur bdag gzhan brje ba sgoms// byang chub sems kyis khong dros nas// 'gro la phan thogs ngang gis 'byung*// thub bstan gces phrug gzhon nu ma// chos min nad kyis thebs pa na// 'khrul med sman pa chen po'i bu// gcig gis kyang ni de 'tsho nus// chos kyi gdung tsam 'dzin pa dang*// chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba dang*// chos med mi rnams srid mtsho las// chos kyis grol ba dag dang gsum// dang po kho nas sangs rgyas dang*// rgyal ba'i sras dang mkhan po dang*// dge ba'i bshes dang dam tshig gi /slob dpon dgyes pa'i mchod pa'o// sman pa mkhas pa mchod pa dang*// gsal stong 'dzin med 'char ba dang*// snying rje chen po g.yos bya'i phyir// ja sbyor gcig gi rten yang 'bul// gser mdog can nas phul ba dge/ ༈ //bstan gcig pa byang chub dpal la gnang ba// ༄// ka bcu 'dzin pa'i slob dpon la// kha po can gyi stan gcig pas// ga bur dri gsung ldan pa'i spos// nga bdag spangs te lan gnyis phul// ca re nya re lan med pa// cha shas mdzes pa'i 'chad rtsod dang*// ja dang bsres pa'i rtsom pa dang*// nya lto pa ltar sgom pas brel// ta re'i bcom ldan mchod pa dang*// tha mal rang sems dwangs pa la// da lta ga bur spos de mchis// na gi'i sbyor ba slar yang zhu// pa ra mi tā thal phreng ni// pha rol rgol ba pham byed de// ba thag drwa bar bcug ces pas// ma lus lhag ma ngas ma byas// tsa ra rtse ra ma gsung bar// tsha grang sdug bsngal khyad gsad la// dza ya mchod pa'i bya ba de// wa le sems la gsal bzhin mdzod// zha long sogs la lha bshos kyi// za ma ser sna med par mthong*// 'a cag myur du phrad nas kyang*// ya rabs gleng mo mgyogs por byed// ra ba'i mtshams las mi 'da' rnams// la mor dgag dbye mdzad nus na// sha na'i gos can ji bzhin du// sa steng ngur smrig mdangs kyis mtshon// ha cang lci ba'i mchod sgrom des// ha las mgrin pa mi ngar ba// a re dga' zhes khur mdzod dang*// a la la ba'i bde 'bras 'byung*// spos khang tshogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi// spos snod gnyis po phyir 'bul bas// spos 'ga' slar yang 'byor pa dang*// spos rdol dbyings su zhi gyur cig/

༈ //'dzam yul mang gar sangs rgyas bzang po la gnang ba// ༄// dpal ldan 'dzam yul ṣaṃ ka ra// bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dpal bzang po'i// yi ge rgya ja bzang po yi// rten bcas gang 'dir 'phrod pas spro// gang 'dir gtsang gi sa phyogs su// khams bzang rgyan drug mkhas pa'i gzhung*// 'khyog po'i lam nas drang po yi// lam du 'dren pa'i lung dang ni// rigs pa'i gnas la yid 'grus shing*// rnam par mi g.yeng legs bshad dag /ri mor bgyis pa'ang phal cher grub// don gnyer blo gsal yid gzhungs pa// mang pos de yi brgyud pa'ang 'dzin// de nas ha cang mi ring zhing*// mthar byed khyim du ma song bar// dben pa'i gnas su stong pa nyid// snying rje'i snying po can goms zhes// yid kyi lha dag de skad smra// khyed kyang thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la// mi g.yel thun mtshams kun du yang*// nges don gsal byed lung rigs kyi// gnas la nges par goms byos shig /lung rigs min pas nges pa'i don// go byed tshad ma mi bskrun zhing*// tshad mas ma drangs goms bya'i don// ring du goms kyang ngal ba tsam// snying po 'gyur gyi don de la// gsal snang mngon sum 'byung mi 'gyur// lung la yid brton byed pa yang*// dpyad pa gsum gyis dag nas yin// rigs pa'i gnas la ma byang na// dpyad pa gsum gyis ji ltar 'dag /de phyir phyi rol don 'gog gi /rigs pas gzung bya'i yul khegs shig /gzung ba med na 'dzin pa yang*// lta zhig ci 'tshal de nas ni// gnyis med ye shes las bsgrubs pa'i// phyi nang bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*// ye shes nyid kyang rang ngo bos// stong pa'i tshul la gdeng thob nas// rim gnyis zab mo'i gsang tshig shes// gang phyir de phyir bskyed rim gyis// sbyang gzhi sbyang bya 'phrod 'dod na// byams pa'i gzhung la nang byan tshud// gnyis med ye shes lhar zhen pa// spong byed gnyen po go 'dod na// thal rang nyi zla'i 'gros chen long*// rang byin brlabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo sgom pa gnyis med kyi// ye shes mngon du byed pa'i thabs// 'gran zla bral ba yin mod kyang*// ye shes de la mchog nyid du// mtshan mar zhen pa 'gog mi nus// de la zhen pa ma log na// grangs can gzhung lugs goms pa bzhin// slar yang srid pa'i gnas su ltung*// grangs can pa rnams gnyis med kyi// shes pas sems can kun la khyab// de phyir sems can thams cad kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i snying po can// yin zhes smra ba drang bya'i phyir// rgyal bas sems can thams cad kyang*// sangs rgyas snying po can no zhes// 'khor lo tha ma'i mdor gsungs pa// 'khor lo bar ma'i mdo rnams su// chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis// stong pa'i tshul la blo byang ba'i// slob ma rnams la dgongs pa yin// legs bshad snying po mdor bsdus pa// 'di yis rang gi rgyud smin zhing*// gzhan gyi rgyud kyang grol byas nas// bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis spyon// gro bzhin can gyi yar tshes la// gtsang g.yas ru'i sa'i thig le// gser mdog can nas phul//

༈ //spom 'khor dgon gsar ba sangs rgyas rdo rje la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ gang yang bsam pa thag pa yis// nges par skyabs su song gyur na// dgos pa'i don rnams slu med par// rtsol mdzad de yi khyod bsrungs shig /rnam par rtog pas mi bskyod pa'i// sems kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig gi /slob dpon las ni brda' sprod pa// gsang sngags 'dzin pa khyod grub cig /gang khyod 'tsho bzhes dge ba dang*// nyer 'tshe bral ba'i skabs shig nas// sdebs sbyor ldan pa'i phrin yig kyang*// ja dkar brten dang bcas te 'phrod// de yi dge bas gnas skabs su// 'chi med bdud rtsis 'tsho ba dang*// mthar thug chos kyis phongs rnams la// bdud rtsi'i sgo brgya dbye bar shog /'dir yang rnam g.yeng smrig rgyu yi// thang chen yangs po brgya rgal nas// gtsang phyogs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho na// bstan la rim gro byed cing dge /rje btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis// bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu gang*// rdo rje rnam gsum mtshon byed pa// lhag mar lus pa rgyas btab 'bul// slar yang ring du 'tsho ba dang*// lam gyi bar chad sel ba dang*// bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i rgyu// slob ma'i tshogs la phan byed shog/ //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// ༈ //dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dbang rtsed gdong pa'i drung du phul ba// ༄// dbang bdag po chen po'i zhabs kyi padmo dam pa'i drung du/ zhu ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor bzang po la mi g.yel ba'i ngang nas/ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las mtha' dag la/ bka' lung gis khyab cing*/ skye 'gro mang po'i bsod nams kyi dpal du zhabs brtan par gdan chags par bzhugs pa/ thugs rjes gzung lags/ skabs kyi zhu don/ 'di nas kyi dge 'dun pa thogs gcig de phyogs su bsod snyoms la thegs pa/ thugs rje spyan ras nye bar gzigs pa mkhyen lags/ zhes pa'i mtshon byed/ spyan zur du 'bebs pa'i rten/

mtshon par 'di skad ces/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi dbang phyug sa skya pa// rje btsun sras bcas kun gyi gdung 'tshob cing*// chos dang srid kyi rnam rgyal khang bzangs su// rnam dkar phrin las khri la zhabs brtan shig /ces pa'i shis pa lan brgyar brjod nas 'bul// ༈ //shar kha ba'i bdag chen don 'phags pa la gnang ba// ༄// brgya byin thod kyi nor bu'i khri// rab 'khod zhabs sen dmar 'od la// 'char ka'i mdangs kyis nyer 'khyud pa// mes po'i lha yis 'dir srungs shig /'chi bdag nub kyi ri bo brgya// rnam par rgal nas lugs gnyis kyi// shar gyi ri la gang 'char ba// sa skyong nyi ma de rgyal gyur// de nas de yi mdun sa ni// phan dang bde ba'i 'jug ngogs che// bstan 'dzin mgrin pa mngon mtho ba// yid 'ong ngo mtshar de'i drung du// zhe sar ldan pa'i bla gos ni// zlum por bgos nas rgyal ba dang*// bkra shis me tog gsar pa yang*// mchod par phul nas mchid 'di zhu// mthon po'i rigs 'khrungs ston pa yi// zhabs 'bring bstan pa'i rim gro pa// sa chen skyong mdzad blon por bcas// gzhan las khyad par 'phags de kun// ma la ya rlung gis drangs pa'i// ha ri tsandan dri gzhon gyis// bsil bar byas pa'i rgyal khang du// phrag dog tshad pa'i zhugs kyi ni// gdung byed skyong ba'i go skabs ci// grogs dag snying las bskyungs shig ces// srid pa'i lha dag snyan sgrogs pa// thos nas sems kyi spro ba 'phel// tshangs par spyod pa'i nags khrod na// zhi ba'i stan 'jam la sred cing*// 'dod ldan lam du mi rgyu ba'i// drang srong de yang 'di na dge /sa skyong legs byas mdza' bo yis// yid kyi shing rta nges drangs pa// drang srong yid kyi sgeg 'chang ma// nam yang mya ngan med pa de// mtshan jus gser gyi me tog ni// ya yor gyur pas yid gdungs kyang*// mi dbang rnam dpyod brtson 'grus kyi// gdong mdzes bstar bas yid drangs so// dpal ldan shar kha'i sde chen gyi// chab srid rin chen bang mdzod na// sngon bsags bsod nams nor bu'i tshogs// chal chol 'khod pas gang gyur pa// 'phral dang 'phral du legs byas kyi// lung thag grims po la brgyus nas// bstan jus nor bu'i do shal gyis// yul gru'i skye mched 'dzin 'tshal lo// zhu yig utpal dkar po'i lte ba la// spyan zur zla zer 'dren pa'i kha lo pas// phrag dog nyin mo'i tsha zer 'gong nus pa'i// dngul dkar ya lad bgos pa 'di phul lo// gang gi rnam dpyod skye mched la gtogs pa'i// sa skyong thugs kyis lang tsho g.yo ldan pa// snyan dngags 'dab brgya'i skyed tshal 'dir spyon la// yid gcugs gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di bzhes shig/

༈ //gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i nang so shākya rgyal mtshan la gnang ba// ༄// mthon po'i rigs 'khrungs mnga' ris kun la snyoms// skye mched rab gtsang rnam dpyod ngang gis gsal// rgyal ba'i bstan la rim gro cher bskyed nas// rtag tu legs bshad tshol ba de drung du// shākya'i sras kyi dge slong bsod snyoms pa// rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung*// rtag tu bde ba'i lam du 'dren brtson zhing*// la lar slob ma'i khur gyis ngal des zhu// khyim dang 'byor pas nges par rgyang srings shing*// sde snod klog pa'i grwa chen 'dir zhugs nas// sil sil bsil byed sgra dang drang srong gi /slong phor thogs pa'i rab byung mched lnga 'di// brtse chen gtong phod ldan pa'i mdun sa der// slong phod lugs brgya bshams nas song lags kyi// lo legs blo gros yangs pa'i yul gyi gru// mthon po'i mkhyen pas dpyad pa de dang der// gser yig lag par thogs pa'i bya ma rta// sgrin 'grus byams par ldan pa re re zhu// zhu phod che la dgongs khrel dang*// bkyon zhal 'byung bar ma gyur cig /ces khyung tshang gser mdog can nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i nang so tshe brtan dpal la gnang ba// ༄// sa skyong chen po'i drung du/ zhu ba/ bka' shog gnang sbyin dang bcas pa phebs pas thugs rjes bzung lags/ chos rje rin po che'i drung du/ 'bul rgyu'i rten bcas kyang ma nyams par phebs pa bzhin/ deng sang gres kyi phu'i dben gnas bsam gtan sdings zhes bya ba zhig na/ sku khams shin tu bzang zhing thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs pa der mi 'gyang bar 'bul du gtong bar yod lags/ rang 'od mdangs kyis dkar ba'i pa wa sangs// mtshan mo'i mkha' la zla ba ltar rlom yang*// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i nyi ma ni// rin chen spungs pa'i shar gyi ri nas shar// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i me tog mda'// sbrang rtsi'i dgra bo'i gzhu la nyer zhon nas// sgra med 'jab pa'i g.yul gyi rgyal thabs mkhan// bsod nams pho brang dbus su zhabs brtan shig

/ces rgyal ba dang*/ shis pa 'bul ba'i mtshon du/ tiṃ dmar zhig gi sne la phyag rgyas btab pa 'bul/ nyer bdun la gser mdog can nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //bod rjes btsad po'i rigs su yum gling dkar ba'i rgyal bu la gnang ba// ༄// gru 'dzin chos kyi pho brang mthon po nas// 'jig rten kun la snyoms par nyer gzigs pa'i// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob pa// srong btsan mes po'i dbon sras de drung du// 'tshe med zhi ba'i nags kyi lding khang na// gsung rab bdud rtsi'i nying khus yid myos nas// snyoms las bde ba'i bstan 'dzin la dga' yang*// mang du klog pa'i ngal ba can des zhus// gang khyod rigs kyi bgos skal kun las mtho// rnam dpyod skye mched mtshar bas gzhan yid 'phrog /bstan la rim gror mdzad pas thugs dge ba// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis nges bsrungs shig /blo gros 'dzum zer g.yo ba'i zhal gyi sgor// rtse 'dod srid zhi'i dbal gyis sgeg chags pa'i// mang thos yid kyi mya ngan med ma dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur byos shig /ces shis brjod 'bul ba'i rten mtshon byed du ba so'i za ma tog sindu ra'i thig les spras pa zhig 'bul// ༈ //glo bor bzhugs pa'i bdag mo slob dpon ma la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba yi// rgyal po rgya nag stong khun gyis// mchod dang bkur ba'i gnas thob pa// dpal ldan sa skya'i mnga' bdag gi /rgyud 'khrungs rig 'dzin slob dpon ma// dkon mchog rgyal mo bsod nams dang*// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub dang*// srid pa'i 'byor ba phun tshogs zhes// bden stobs brjod pa'i mthu grub pa// dzo gi a mṛ nā tha 'di// sngon nas zhal 'tsho slar song ba// de la mkho dgu'i chas bstab nas// 'phags yul gnas chen so so bar// skabs kyi smon lam ci mchis dang*// bden stobs gang 'tsham gdab tu chug

/des de 'grub par gdon mi 'tshal// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //glo bo'i dpon po drung bkra shis mgon la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ bkra shis nyin mo'i mgon gang gi /snyan grags 'od phreng phyogs rnams su// 'phro phyir 'phags yul nas 'ongs pa'i// dzo gi a mṛ nā tha 'dis// gangs can yul ljongs kun 'khor nas// slar yang 'phags pa'i yul du chas// skabs der bkra shis pa yi mgon// shul rings 'gron po'i bsti gnas mchog /byams pa'i dpag bsam ljon pa ni// gtong phod lugs brgya'i 'dab phreng can// 'dod dgu'i grib bsil gyen du yang*// mgyogs par 'phro na phongs pa dang*// dka' thub can la lta ci zhes// snyan grags khor yug rab yangs pa'i// 'byor pa'i skyed tshal der song gi /thugs rje'i spyan gyis nyer bzung nas// byams pa'i phyag ring rkyong bar shog /g.yas ru gtsang gi sa yi chu// gser mdog can nas 'di springs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ //glo bo'i dpon po drung a seng la gnang ba// ༄// skyabs bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi zhabs 'bring rim gro pa chen po/ rang srid byams pas 'tsho mdzad gang de'i drung du/ shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pas zhu ba/ gang nyid dal 'byor gyi gru bo che 'tsho zhing*/ cho 'brang dang*/ lang tsho'i dpal la mthar byed kyi snyems pa mi mnga' ba'i ngang tshul bzang pos/ rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las chen po la nye bar 'grus shing*/ gegs med pa'i go 'phang mchog tu nye bar son pa'i skabs nas/ bka' stsal ri mor springs pa/ sa le sbram zung du 'jug pa'i skyes dang bcas te/ gya gyu'i lam gyi 'tshe bas ma gtses par/ 'dod bya'i yul gyi mdza' bo'i khyim du bde bar 'ongs shing phebs pas/ dga' zhing*/ mgu la/ rangs nas/ yid gcugs pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba mang du bgyis so// nyid kyi mnga' ris ljongs dang ri sul na// mgon med bag phebs gyur pa'i brtul zhugs can// mthar byed pho nya'i lam las bsrungs mdzad na// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal de phyag tu 'ong*// pha rol mi bsrun rtsub mo'i dpa' ngar can// snying rje'i dpung dang byams pas 'tsho mdzad na// sa gsum las rgyal lhun po'i pho brang du// rgyal rnga rdung byed brgya byin nyid du 'gyur// zhes shis pa brjod pa'i me tog gi mtshon byed/

gos mdog can kha gang gi phyi thums la rgya 'byar ba 'bul/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gsum la/ khyung tshang gser mdog can nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //slar yang de nyid la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ mthon po'i go sa nges bzung nas// skye mched gtsang zhing blo gsal ba// dpa' zhing brtul phod dkyel mdzangs can// mi yi seng ge khyod drung du// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pas// mchid 'phrin springs pa 'di bzhes shig /gang khyod nges par 'tsho ba dang*// gzhan gyi mi bskrun chos dang ni// srid pa'i 'byor pas kun dga' zhes// snyan grags nyi ma'i zer bzhin 'phro// 'dir yang bstan pa'i bcud chen pos// nges par sim nas gzhan zer la// 'gram chu mi ldang chog shes kyi// stan 'jam la 'khod 'tsho zhing dge /gang der dwang bas dge ba dang*// sdang bas nyes par spyod byed pa// spel mar mdzad na glang chen gyi// khrus bzhin zin pa med 'gyur ba// de phyir legs byas gang gang gi /'bras bu de la yun ring thogs// de nas khong khro las gyur pa'i// nag po'i las rnams rgyang ring bsrings// yang na dge ba'i sa bon ni// 'joms byed sdig pa'i las mi srid// mi dge'i rtsa ba drungs 'byin pa'i// byang chub thugs dang 'bral med zhu// snyel bskul padma'i ge sar la// 'dren byed bung ba rol ba'i rten// dpag bsam sbrang rtsi dog pa ni// gdams pa'i bcud du mchod byed lags// snron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes la// g.yas ru gtsang gi sa yi cha// gser mdog 'dzin pa'i chos kyi grwa// 'dun sa yangs pa de nas zhus// //maṅga laṃ bha wantu// ༈ //glo bo'i dpon po drung aṃ grags pa mtha' yas la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ skyabs slu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang*/ srog 'tsho ba dang*/ dam tshig gi slob dpon so so'i byin gyis brlabs dang*/

rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i nus pa dpag par dka' zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu yis/ aṃ grags pa mtha' yas/ chos dang srid kyi mgon po gang nyid/ myur ba kho nar phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mthon po nges par 'dzin grub par gyur cig ring du 'tsho zhing*/ mang po'i rna lam snyan par gyur cig lang tsho'i dpag bsam rigs par rgyas nas/ skye 'gro mang po'i yid la nye bar sim zhing*/ bde ba sbyin par gyur cig sgrin zhing*/ 'grus la/ rnam par gyur nas/ dkyel mdzangs dang*/ dpal gyi khri la gdan brtan zhing*/ mngon par mtho bar gyur cig ldan pa dang*/ 'du ba dang*/ rkyang pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar gyur cig gang la phrag dog pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa bgyid pa dang*/ bgegs kyi ris brgyad khri bzhi stong po gang dag stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rdo rjes 'jebs pa nyid du 'joms par gyur cig gang la ming gi skyes len du byin pa'i rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba ma rnying cing*/ ma nyams pa rnam pa gsum po de dang de thugs rje dang*/ mkhyen pa dang*/ nus mthu can gsum gyi spyan lam du phul ba'i dge bas/ rigs kyi sras nyid kyi do shal dang*/ mgo bo'i cod paṇa la bkra shis pa'i me tog gi phreng ba 'ching zhing*/ mtshar du dngar bas rnam par rgyan par gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs dang*/ shis brjod kyi phreng ba ma nyams pa'i mtshon byed du/ tsandan dmar po'i bgrang phreng*/ rigs par byin gyis brlabs nas/ ring du bgrang pa brgya rtsa lhag tsam/ ma na hu'i mdo 'dzin tog dang bcas pa la rgyas btab pa 'bul/ cho 'phrul bstan pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ gser mdog can gyi dben gnas dam pa nas phul ba'i zhu yig/ ༈ //slar yang de nyid la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ dpal chos 'khor gser mdog can gyi 'dun sa yangs po nas/ a haṃ grags pa mtha' yas mgon po rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog tu dge zhing grags pa grub par gyur cig

gang nyid kyi mchid shog lhag bsam dge ba'i ljon phreng du mas nye bar bskrun pa'i sbur len dkar po'i skyes dang bcas pa/ 'dir smin zhing*/ grub pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i cha shas ji tsam zhig nye bar thob pa de thams cad ni/ rigs kyi yab dang yum du gyur pa'i 'gro ba pa mtha' dag dang thun mong du byas te/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phul lo// de'i byin gyis brlabs kyi byin rlabs kyis/ sku la snyun mi mnga' zhing*/ sku tshe ring bar gyur cig sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba dang*/ chos kyi dngos po don du gnyer ba dang*/ 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phud dud du bya ba dag dang mi 'bral zhing*/ mang pos bsnyen zhing kun nas bkur ba'i dbang phyug dam pa grub par gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i sngags/ phyag rgyas mngon par 'dus byas pa'i rdo rje'i mdud pa la rgyas btab pa 'bul/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la shis par brjod pa'o// ༈ //rong ra lngar nang chen ra lod rdo rje'i zhu lan du gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ ngo mtshar lha yul gyi brgya byin sa la 'phos pa'i mi dbang lha'i nor bu bzang po'i nang blon/ bstan pa rin po che la dgongs pa rnam par dag pa mnga' ba de la zhe sa bgyis pa sngon du btang ste/ rgyal ba dang shis pa brjod nas/ bka' phrin stsal ba'i mchid lan du zhu ba ni/ kun gyi gtsug rgyan rin chen rnam gsum gyi// zhabs sen dpa' bo 'jig med seng ge ni// khyed kyi ral pa'i nags la mngon dga' bas// sa skyong blon por bcas pa rgyal gyur cig /thub bstan 'ba' zhig dgongs pa'i mdza' bo ni// khyod thugs ral pa dmar po'i thig le 'dzin// khyod kyi snyan grags gser gyi ngang pa ni// bstan 'dzin yongs kyi rna ba'i chu gter rgyan /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i ya mtshan mdzes sdug kun// mi dbang bsod nams pang par legs 'phos nas// chos dang srid kyi sgo mo stong phrag can// pho brang ra lnga'i bdud rtsi'i chu gter nas// spring yig ngang mo'i mgrin par chos kyi skyes// gsal bar bris pa'i dge mtshan ri mo can// 'jig rten gzhung lugs mkhyen pa'i gtam gyis ni// phan par dgongs pa'i legs bshad ngar sgra can// thugs dgongs dag pa'i lam chen gsum bsgrod nas// bstan la rim gror bgyid pa'i mgron po gang*// don mthun pho nyas ji ltar khrid pa'i lam// 'khyog pa med par gnas 'dir bag phebs nas// mang du thos pa'i chu gter 'gram ngogs na// legs bshad mgrin pa'i rnga sgra ma nyams shing*// bstan la bsam pa'i thig phreng phra mo can// blo bzang ngang pa de dang bka' mchid bgyis// mang thos gnyis 'thung rigs pa'i mche ba can// gsung rab shes pa'i chang gis rab myos nas// snyoms las bde ba'i mal du gnyid log tshe// blo chen lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i rnam dpyod dang*// bstan 'dzin yongs la snyoms pa'i brtse ba can// des gsung snyan pa'i lcag gi bskul ba na// rang nus bstan pa'i khur gcig cis mi 'degs// brtse chen des kyang ring nas skyong 'tshal lo// da lta rin chen spungs pa'i mnga' ris na// mdo sngags nyi zla'i 'gros gnyis lhag par gsal// slar yang bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen bzhi// rtsa 'jug nor bu 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs der// ngo mtshar lung dang rigs pa'i rnga sgra can// phrin las gdugs dkar phyogs brgyar gsal gyur cig

/bsod nams zhabs brtan dad pa'i rtsa ba can// rnam dpyod mkhyen yangs gtong phod lo 'dab rgyas// 'byor pa'i 'bras bu dud cing brjid chags pas// bstan 'dzin mgron po ngal gso'i bsti gnas mchog /blon chen bsod nams 'byor pa zhabs brtan zhing*// 'jig rten phan bde ji snyed pa// de kun rgyal ba'i bstan pa la// bstan pa de 'dzin skyes bu la// bstan 'dzin sbyin pa'i bdag po la// sbyin bdag 'byor dang gtong phod la// rag las de phyir bstan pa yi// dpag bsam ljon pa'i rtsa ba ni// sa skyong blon por bcas pa lags// ༈ //snar thang chos sde'i gtong dpon pa'i sras la gnang ba// ༄// lha dbang dbang po'i dgra dang pad dkar mig /mig gsum pas mchod mchod sbyin brgya pa'i lha// lha min las rgyal rgyal ba de yi gsung*// gsung dbyangs dbyangs kyi phreng ba snyan gyur cig /gnyen mtshams ma ma drug gi yid 'dren pa'i// rnam dpyod smin legs ldan pa'i gdong drug pa// rig gnas rma bya'i khri la 'khod bzhin du// sgrin 'grus dkyel mdzangs rgyan gyis khyod dge'am// ngag gi dbang po'i tshems dkar phreng ba las// gshin par gzhibs pa'i dbyangs can mgrin pa'i bcud// sbrang rtsi'i dgra bos ma myangs ro brgya pa// rnam dpyod kha sgor 'bab pa'ang 'di na dge /chos 'dod yid kyi 'khril shing gzhon nu ma// thub bstan nags kyi dpag bsam lang tsho la// nye bar sim pa'i rol brtsed bgrang yis kyi// 'chi med dbang po'i dga' ston lta 'dod dam// tshul khrims dag pa'i mdza' bo 'dren mkhas pa'i// nges 'byung yid kyi gar mkhan ma de yis// lus ngag yid kyi zlos gar ci yang byas// lan gcig gya gyu'i lam du song min nam// mang thos chos kyi skye mched gsar pa la// lta 'dod yid kyi lha gzhon 'ga' yod na// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi dpyang thag la// som nyi spangs pa'i lag pas 'jug byed mkhan// dal 'byor gru chen 'dzin pa'i kha lo pas// phan bde'i gnas su bde bar bkri min nam// sim byed snyan pa sbyin pos yid drangs nas// slong mkhas thub pa'i rjes 'jug slong ba po// snyan dngags sil sil dang bcas der song gi

/re ba'i yid kyi shing rta ngoms gyur cig /nyer gsum la gser mdog can nas phul// ༈ //'phan yul grog 'khar ba la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ yon pa'i lam du mi 'jug pa'i// yon bdag rdo rje bsam grub kyis// yon tan can gyi rin rgyal la// yon rdzongs dgos pa med gyur kyang*// yon sbyong nus pa yin pa'i phyir// yon phul nas ni bsod nams tshogs// yon gyis slu bar mdzad pa dang*// yon bshad 'di yang gsan par byos// ha cang rig pa rno drags na// ha las mang po dran pa srid// ha sa ho sa'i skabs shig tu// ha thal dbyen gyis bcugs pa srid// bden brdzun kun la brtags dpyad nas// bden pa 'ba' zhig bsrungs mdzad na// bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis dang*// bden gtam 'ba' zhig phyag tu 'ong*// zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la// khyung tshang gser mdog can nas phul// ༈ //chos sdings pa'i khams pa rnams la gnang ba// ༄// oṃ swasti/ a rgyal mi nyag ring mo dang*// a khro nyag rong dpon rgan dang*// a ga'i yon bdag su bzhugs sogs// a mes khams pa dkyel mdzangs can// chos sdings ru bar bzhugs rnams dgongs// chos grwa 'di pa'i spyi bsod pa// chos rgyags ldangs pa slong bzhed nas// chos bshad byed kyin song yod do// thugs tshig mang po mi za bar// thugs 'dogs gang yod byas gyur na// thugs bzhed gang yod spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje chen pos bsgrub par nges// zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer gsum la gser mdog can nas phul// ༈ //rong ston chos kyi rje'i nye gnas pa nam mkha' dpal ldan pa'i zhu 'phrin gyi lan// ༄// sku btsun btsun pa'i dbang po shā ri'i bu// gsung mkhas mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇḍi ta// thugs bzang bzang po yongs kyi mchod pa'i gnas// skyes chen chen po'i ngang tshul can khyod dge /snyan grags pha mtha' yas par song gyur kyang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs kyi rwa ba las// nam yang mi 'da' thos bsam bsgom pa yi// ngang tshul can khyod rtag par zhabs brtan shog

/bdud rtsi'i 'bab stegs ngo mtshar can// dpag bsam ljon pa'i lang tsho ma// spring yig 'khril shing gzhon nu mas// nye bar 'khril ba 'dir 'ongs so// de nas de yi kun dga' la// nye bar 'khril ba'i yid kyi ni// mā li gsar pa'i bzhad phreng can// 'dzum dkar po yi lang tsho ma// ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol rtsed mkhan// tsandan bsil ba'i mdangs 'phro ba// ma la ya rlung 'jam po la// nye bar 'khril ba'i dri bsung can// 'du 'dzis dben po'i nags khrod 'dir// mtshar du dngar ba e ma ho// de nas dge ba'i bshes 'di yi// yid kyi ku mud gsar pa la// gsung 'jam zla 'od gzhon nu mas// nye bar 'khril ba'i chos kyi ni// 'brel ba bzang po gnang ba gces// zhib zhus rin chen phreng ba kun// blo gsal 'di yis mgul na yod// bzhed na zhus lan phyag gis ni// mgyogs par long la mgul rgyan mdzod// ༈ //bzhi sde mkhyen rabs pa'i dbon po nam mkha' brtan pa'i zhu 'phrin gyi lan// ༄// rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun rdo rje da nga*// gtan du slu med rin chen dkon mchog gsum// bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam can rgya mtsho yis// chos kyi gdung 'dzin gang khyod deng 'dir bsrungs// nam yang blo mig gyen du 'degs pa dang*// mkha' bzhin kun la thogs pa med pa dang*// mdzangs shing 'grus pa'i gom stabs brtan pa dang*// byams pa'i 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro khyod kyi// phrin yig 'dzum dkar skyes kyi do shal can// bag phebs lang tsho ldan pa 'dir 'ongs nas// yid gcugs gtam gyi sbyor ba ci yang byas// de nas mchid lan rol mor byed pa ni// shes rab shes bya'i gnas la 'phro ba dang*// thugs rgyud thugs rjes nges par bltams pa dang*// kun kyang kun nas bkur zhing yid dkar ba// 'di gsum 'di dang gzhan du dge ba'i dpal// 'dod don stsol ba'i lha dag la// 'dod 'dun yid kyis gsol btab na// 'dod pa'i don la gegs med cing*// 'dod bya'i gnas su bde bar son// gang du 'khod pa'i gnas dag tu// gang la yid gnyis mi 'tshal bar// gang zhig bsnyen cing bag phab na// gang dang 'tshams pa'i 'dod dgu 'byung*//

༈ //glo bo chos mdzad blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhu 'phrin gyi lan du gnang ba// ༄// mthon po'i rigs kyi dgung las ma lhung zhing*// dkyel mdzangs rnam dpyod mtshar ba'i 'od brgya pa// ngur smrig mtshams sprin gsar pa'i bla gos kyi// lhab lhub kyis klubs dang 'dren gang de'i drung*// shākya'i sras kyi rje 'jug bsod snyoms pas// mchid lan ri mor springs pa 'di bzhes shig /a mes gong ma'i rigs brgyud ma nyams shing*// srid la gdung 'tshob chos kyi brgyud 'phel ba// gang khyod sdig grogs lag pas ma bzung bar// dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs bzung ngo mtshar to// blo bzang chos la bskul ba'i mchid gros kyis// rgyal ba'i bstan la nges 'byung mtshan dkar bas// dpal ldan skal ba bzang por byas khyod kyi// mchid shog pho nyas rin chen mgul phreng can// 'du 'dzi'i gtam dang skye bo'i rgyun lugs kyis// ring du bsrings pa'i ri sul dben pa na// mang thos klog pa pa zhig ting 'dzin las// nges par gzhol ba'i sug par gegs med phyin// glo ba nye zhing yid la gcags pa'i gtam// don gsal tshig mdzangs yid gcugs rol mo yis// bag phebs gyur pa'i zlos gar ci yang byas// bzhed pa'i don la gegs yod ma gyur cig /grangs med bskal bar gang gi ming tsam yang*// rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor yid bzhin nor// gang gi phyag tu 'bad med 'ongs gyur pa// rang srog ji bzhin gces par de bzung shig /srid pa'i 'byor pa dbang po'i gzhung lta bu// ji tsam spyad kyang ngoms pa'i skabs bral zhing*// nam zhig phongs pa'i gnas su lhung byed pa// de 'dra de la dpyod ldan su yid rton// 'byor ldan khyim nas nges par 'byung dka'i phyir// ha cang phyug po'i khyim du mi skye bar// shā ri'i bu yis lan brgyar smon lam btab// de don 'tshal nas nges par gzengs bstod shig/

༈ //mnga' ris rdzong kha ba'i mnga' bdag chos rgyal nor bu la phul ba// ༄// 'jig rten dbang po'i thugs rje'i 'dzum phreng las// dal bur babs pa'i rigs kyi thig le zhig /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du shar gyur pa// srong btsan sras kyi zla ba khyod drung du// ring nas phul ba'i zhu mchid 'di bzhes shig /rigs kyis che ba 'gro mang yongs kyis bkur// sku lus rgyal mtshan sa chen 'di yis bzung*// chab srid dbu rmog gong nas gong dag tu// rnam par btsan zhes dga' ba ci yang 'phel// slar yang grags pa'i 'od dkar ma nyams shing*// mang thos rnam dpyod nyin dang mtshan la ni// rnam par bsags pas gang zhing rgyas pa la// lha min lag pas rtsen par ma gyur cig /gang khyod snying rje'i ljon phreng rgyas pa la// nye bar sim pa'i rnam dpyod lang tsho ni// thub rnams dges pa'i skye mched mtshar ba dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur blangs so// de nas thugs rje'i sman ljongs nyams dga' bar// kun la snyoms pa'i phan bde'i grib bsil ni// gtong phod lugs brgya ldan pa'i khor yug can// phongs pa yongs kyi bsti gnas lags par drang*// gang 'dir gzhan gyis ma myangs ro brgya pa// rnam dpyod hub kyis 'thungs pas rab myos nas// chags sdang rtsub mo'i lam du mi nyal bar// nges don bdud rtsi'i 'bab stegs lhur blangs so// mang thos lang tsho yol ba'i spong ba pa// gdung skyob ljon pa'i drung du gnas byos zhes// dge sbyong chen po'i gsung las 'khums pa na// drang srong chen po brtul zhugs gzung bya'i phyir// sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur blangs gyur pa na// 'gro kun yid rab 'dren pa'i bsil byed ni// ngo mtshar lugs brgya ldan pa 'dir stsol shig/ ༈ //byang pa bdag po rnam rgyal grags pa la tsandan dkar po'i dum bu zhig gi rten dang bcas phul ba// ༄// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal bzung nas// nam yang kun gyi bla na bzhugs gyur cing*// rig gnas kun mkhyen nges par grub dbang po// rnam dkar grags pa bzang po'i zhabs drung du// ston pa'i rjes 'jug khrims ldan dge slong zhig

/ngur smrig bla gos phrag pa gcig bgos te// gus pa'i mgrin pa btud nas dul ba yi// thal mo sbyar te thog mar shis pa 'bul// srog rtsol 'chi med dbang po'i rdo rje yis// las rlung khros pa'i 'chi bdag srog gi dgra// rtag tu dbu ma'i rgya mtshor 'ching mdzad pa'i// 'chi med grub pa'i lha de khyod bsrungs shig /gang sku sku lnga'i bdag nyid zla ba bzang*// de gsung gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal grags// nyid thugs thugs rje'i gter mdzod pad dkar gyis// rnam rgyal rgyal ba'i sras la g.yo med mdzod// de ltar shis pa phul nas/ the tshom can gyi don 'ga' zhig zhus pa'i lan/ bka' stsal pa'i slad du/ mchid phrin 'ga' zhig zhu ba ni/ sku'i rdo rje dus min 'chi bdag gi /sgra gcan lam las ring du gol gyur kyang*// gsung gi rdo rjes nyi zla'i rgyu ba kun// khyab 'jug lam du 'jug par mdzad de ci// 'jig rten lugs kyi rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin kyang*// rtag tu chos kyi rgyal por bzhugs de ci// snyan grags kun gyi rna bar ster mdzad kyang*// legs bshad nyid zhal gcig pus 'dzin de ci// zhal sgor rnam dpyod nyi ma 'char bzhin du// ljags rtser legs bshad utpal bzhad pa ci// mkhyen pa'i ri mo kun la ston mdzad kyang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug thugs la sbed pa ci// rigs dang go 'phangs lhun po'i rtog gi mtho// khengs dang dregs pa dbang chen gzhi las dma'// mkhyen pa'i khog yug 'bum phrag bzhi ldan pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i gter mdzod ma lags sam// sngon med legs bshad padma rā ga'i phreng*// rnam dpyod gser gyi nyag thag la brgyus pa// nam yang gzhan gyi mgrin par stsol mdzad na// da dung legs bshad lhag ma 'ga' mchis sam// mdo dang rgyud sde gong ma'i man ngag dang*// tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ma lus pa// nyid rang gcig po'i thugs mtshor bsdus mdzad pa// gzhan dag chos kyi skal bas pham gyis dogs// 'on kyang chos kyi chu bo 'bum phrag tsam// khyod blo gting mtha' yangs par ngal gso nas// chos dang srid kyi chu bo stong phrag gis// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rgud pa sel bar nges// rang sde byams pa'i bdud rtsis skyong ba dang*// gzhan sde grags pa'i dpung gis gnon pa dang*// dkon mchog rnam gsum gus pas mchod mdzad nas// bsod nams gser gyi gzhi la zhabs bstan cig

/dpung ldan sa skyong rgyal po mang yod kyang*// mkhas shing dul ba'i rgya mtsho khyed gcig pu// la la smra mkhas lce bde don gsal yang*// rig 'dzin sa la bzhugs pa nyid gcig yin// chos dang sbyin pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phye nas// bsod nams dpung gis bdud sde gzhom pa dang*// nang gi de nyid sems pa la bzhugs nas// sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis rlob par rigs// zhes pa'i phyag rten mtshon byed sku gsum thugs kyi rnyog pa mtha' dag sel bar nges pa'i tsandan dkar po'i dum bu zhig la hung la 'byar ba 'bul/ tshes bco lnga la zhu yig/ ༈ //shar kha ba'i bdag po sog po 'phags pa la gnang ba// ༄// chos dang srid kyi gzhung lugs gong nas gong*// rnam par 'dren pa'i shing rta la chibs nas// gzhan la med pa'i lugs brgya ston mkhas pa// sa skyong kun gyi nyi ma de drung du// nam yang thos pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' bar// mkhas rnams dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis me tog ni// thub bstan rgyal ba'i dbu la 'bul brtson pa// smra mkhas zlos gar mkhan des mchid 'di zhu// nam yang ngal sos lha brgya'i lag pa yis// 'bad pas bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar pho brang ni// dpal ldan shar kha'i dpag bsam ljon pa de// re 'dod kun gyi bsti gnas lags par drang*// gtong phod sgo brgya phye ba'i 'dun sa der// slong phod lugs brgya shes pa'i sil sil can// smra mkhas lce brgya ldan pa'i lhung lhung gis// thugs rje'i chu gter 'khrug par ma gyur cig /re 'dod yid kyi 'khril shing gzhon nu ma// mthon po'i dpag bsam rtse la snyeg dka' yang*// ngo mtshar 'dzum brgya ldan pa'i bka' lung gis// go skabs phye ba'i lang tsho'i ljon phreng la// ring nas mngags pa'i rab mnyam kha lo pas// gang drangs yid kyi pho nya zung dag ni// 'byor ba'i lam gsum ldan der song lags kyi// gang la ci dga'i don de bde blag stsol// legs bshad gsar pa gaṇḍe'i sgra dbyangs kyis// ma rmongs skye bo ngang gis 'dus gyur pa// rnam dag chos kyi 'du khang yangs pa yi// sgo 'phar mngags pa'i phreng ldan gang de'o// de nas sa skyong grags pa yi// ma la ya'i ngad 'jam la// dal bus 'khyud pa'i bsod nams kyi// tsandan dri bsung kun dga' dpal// zhes ni nags kyi ma li kas// gang bskrun dzā ti'i me tog la// legs bshad li shi dri bsung gis// gang drangs mchid zhus 'di mngags so//

༈ //shar kha ba'i bdag po sog po 'phags pa'i zhu lan du gnang ba// ༄// gzhan dang mi mnyam rnam dpyod lag pa yis// gong nas gong ma'i gnas su 'dzeg mkhas shing*// nam yang bsod nams khri la zhabs brtan pa// mi dbang sa chen skyong mdzad gang de'i drung*// rgyal dang shis brjod zhe sa sngon btang nas// zhu mchid ri mor 'khod pa 'di bzhes shig /yid 'phrog don gyi lang tsho ma mnyam shing*// sdeb legs tshig gi skye mched mtshar ba yi// bka' stsal nyi ma'i bu mo sgeg 'chang ma// don yod mdza' bo'i pad dkar la song ba// thogs med zhags pas 'gro ba'i yid 'dren zhing*// lha rdzas na bza'i lhab lhub g.yo ldan pa'i// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i pho nya ni// snying rje'i gom stabs can des 'dir drangs so// pha rol ri gzhan mthon pos mi gnon pa'i// rgyal srid lhun po'i rtse nas lugs gnyis kyi// rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdungs pa'i zlos gar gyis// yid kyi shing rta ring nas drangs lags kyang*// mang thos lang tsho yol ba'i snyems pa yis// don mthun slob ma'i tshogs dang chabs gcig par// dben gnas nags kyi dpag bsam dga' ma dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur blangs so// bslab sbyang brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i bsod snyoms pa// bas mtha'i gnas su bka' dang bstan bcos kyi// tshig don sems la rnam par g.yeng bral ba// thub pas lan brgyar bsngags pa yang yang dran// ༈ //lum pa ba'i dpon po bkra shis rdo rje la gnang ba ni// ༄// swasti pra dza bhya/ bzang po'i cho ris gong nas gong dag tu// 'dren byed chos kyi shing rta la zhon nas// 'jig rten gzhung lugs gsal ba'i nyi ma yang*// chibs stabs gyen du bskyod ces gang 'dir spro// phun tshogs 'char ka'i mdangs gsal gzhon nu yis// rnam bkra shis par byas pa'i gos dmar gyis// kun nas klubs pa'i 'dzum pa'i 'od phreng can// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi khyod la byin brlabs nas// 'chi med bkra shis pad dkar phreng ba ni// gang gi thod du yengs med 'ching byed cing*// mthar byed mche ba'i ku mud mdangs 'phrog pa'i// rdo rje 'dzin des khyod la cis mi bsrung*// 'jig rten dbang po'i tshems dkar gzhon nu las// dal bur babs pa'i snying rje'i sbu phreng yang*// nyid zhal bim pa'i mdangs dmar gyis 'khyud pa'i// bdud rtsi'i 'bab stegs can de 'thung gyur cig

/sbrang rtsi'i dgra bos ma myangs ro brgya pa// rnam dpyod hub kyis 'thungs nas thub bstan gyi// dpag bsam yongs 'du'i phrag par 'bebs brtson pa'i// bshes gnyen mkha' lding dbang po'ang 'di na dge /mang thos lang tsho yol ba'i dge slong gang*// de don sems dang dben pa'i gtam gyis ni// rtag tu yid kyi shing rta drangs gyur kyang*// bsod snyoms bdud rtsi'i ro yis rnam par g.yeng*// de nas khrims dang thos pas ma btang ba'i// bdag blo nam yang mya ngan med ma ni// thub rnams dgyes pa'i nags kyi mdza' bo dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur len to// bsod snyoms khang chen dbus su khrel yod kyi// rin chen khri la rtag par lus dal zhing*// 'bangs kyi bde skyid tshol bas sems brel ba'i// brtse chen rnam dpyod ldan rnams rgyal por 'os// mgon med snying nas ltos pa'i 'bangs rnams kyi// bde skyid til mar bzhin du 'tshir byed pa// rje dpon nyid du las kyis bskos de dag /brtse med dmyal ba'i bsrungs ma cis mi 'dra// nyid kyis bzung ba'i yul gru'i chu klung na// mgon med bde bar rgyu ba'i srog chags dag /snying rje'i mgon gyis bu bzhin bsrung mdzad na// 'chi med srog gi dpal de phyag tu 'ong*// snyan dngags nyi ma'i bu mo lang tsho can// khyod zhal pad dkar mdza' bo'i tshal du song*// phan tshun yid gcugs 'dzum gyi phreng ba yis// legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di long shig /ces lhag pa'i lha'i rig sngags kyis mngon par sngags pa'i rdo rje'i mdud pa la phyag rgyas btab pa 'bul/ nyer brgyad la rgya ma gser thog gi gtsug lag khang chen po nas zhus// ༈ //'khar rtse khri dpon la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ legs 'doms kun dga'i rnga dbyangs gsar pa yis// tshems dkar dal bur 'khyud pa'i 'dzum zhal yang*// mthar byed 'joms pa'i sgyu 'phrul bgrang yas pa// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyis der bsrung shig

/rigs rus pho brang dbus su khrel yod kyi// rin chen khri las nam yang mi ldang bar// 'bangs kyi bde skyid sems pas dus 'da' ba'i// brtse chen lang tsho can de rgyal por 'os// gang la ltos pa'i mnga' 'bangs ma lus kyi// bde skyid bur shing bzhin du 'tshir byed pa// gshin rjes mngags pa'i pho nya lags par grangs// khengs ldan phrag dog rgyas pa'i nyi ma yang*// rgyal phran skar mas bskor ba'i mngon rlom gyis// dregs pa'i tsha zer rtag tu 'gyed 'dod kyang*// dus kyi sgra gcan gdug pas zos pa mang*// de nas dbang sngon brtsegs pa'i zur phud can// rin chen nal gyi gos dmar gsar pa yi// 'khril shing gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i zhal gyi sgo// bdud rtsi'i 'bab stegs can des khyod zung shig /tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i pho nya dang*// rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal ta pas// bka' stsal dang du nod pa'i lang tsho can// rin chen bsod nams brtsegs pa'i khri la dbang*// pha rol 'drid pa'i gya gyu mang shes kyang*// bsod nams skye mched mdzes pa yod min na// rnam dpyod bu mo'i bzhed dgu rdzogs mi 'gyur// bsod snyoms lang tsho mtshar ba 'dod dgu'i dpal// kho bo'i rnam dpyod thos pa'i chu gter gyi// gting mtha' rtogs byed phrag dog grur zhon nas// tshig mda'i skya ba 'dzin pa'i gnyan pa kun// lus ngag yid gsum ngal byed ma yin nam// ༈ //yang de nyid la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ pra dzā bhya/ chos dbyings zhe ba'i lang tsho la sred pas// nyon mongs zhi ba'i mal nas mi ldang yang*// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol mos kun dga' ba// thub chen ston pa de yis khyod bsrung shig /mgon de'i brtul zhugs mang pos nyer sim nas// mang thos lang tsho yol ba'i drang srong kyang*// rtag tu dben pa'i gtam gyi sbyor mgu mod// bsod snyoms zas kyis 'tsho zhing kun du rgyu// mang thos lhun po'i rtse nas rnam dpyod kyi// rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdungs pa de mthong nas// chos brgyad gar la blta ba'i gzhon nu mas// phrag dog dbyangs su blangs pa 'ga' med dam// gzhan zer rnyog chus myos pa'i khu byug dag

/dben pa'i nags na snyan dbyangs mang sgrog mod// rnam dpyod hub kyis gzhung lugs kun 'thungs nas// dpag bsam bdud rtsir byed pa du zhig yod// gang la 'dun pa'i sa skyong kha lo pas// yid kyi shing rta lan brgyar drangs gyur kyang*// da dung rnam g.yeng 'jigs pa'i thang chen las// ji bzhin rgal bar nus pa min 'di ci// 'dren byed de dag gya gyu'i sbyor ba yis// rkang pa'i goms stabs 'khyog por bzhag min nam// rab mnyam kha lo'i sbyor bas gang drangs pa'i// chos kyi shing rta mgyogs par mi phyin ci// dad 'dun nyi ma'i bu mo lang tsho can// gsung rab pad dkar mdza' bo'i gdong pa la// yid bcugs gtam gyi 'du 'god mang gyur kyang*// sbrang rtsir byed pa'i rol rtsed mi 'byung ci// gang gi gnas mal bde ba'i khur 'dzin pa'i// de yis de la mkho ba'i yo byad kyang*// gtong phod dpung pa'i stobs kyis cis mi 'dzin// 'on kyang sa skyong bzhed pa gang yin pa'o// snga 'gros gdul bya che ba 'bras bu'i lcid// rting 'gros yal ga 'dzin pa'i khur min nam// phyogs kyi tha gru 'degs pa'i rtsol phod kyis// le lo'i stan las myur du ldang dgos sam// nor 'dzin ri rab rgya mtshor bcas pa'i khur// nye dbang min pa dregs ldan su yis 'khur// khyab 'jug rkang rten byed pa'i nor 'dzin kyang*// thub bstan stobs gsum 'degs pa cis mi 'dra// khengs gtam dbyangs su blangs pa'i zlos gar 'di// gzhan dang mi mnyam rnam dpyod lag pa yis// gong nas gong ma'i gnas su 'dzeg bzhed pa'i// sa skyong blon por bcas la mchid du 'bul// ༈ //gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i nang so sgar chen don yod rdo rje la gnang ba// ༄// rigs rus bsod nams mthon po'i khrir 'khod nas// sa chen nyin mor byed pa'i lha sras ni// mdzad srol bzang po'i shing rta la chibs nas// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal 'dzin shog

/ces mchod par brjod nas/ skabs su bab pa'i zhu ba ni/ 'tsho byed dben pa'i gtam gyis yid spro zhing*// mang thos ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i drang srong yang*// 'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri sul phug zhig na// thub chen rgyal ba'i bka' la yid rab rton// brgya byin gzhu ltar bkra ba'i spu sdug can// rnam bkra dar gyi 'ja' tshon ri mo dang*// bdud rtsi'i dgra bos ma myangs ro brgya pa// sa skyong mchod par 'os pa'i sbrang rtsi ni// brgya byin gnyis pa'i mdun sa ma rtogs pa// dka' thub gnas kyi mdun sa 'dir ma byon// de phyir bzhed don bsgrub pa'i sgeg 'chang ma// bka' lung lang tsho ldan pa'i 'dzum dkar can// gang 'dir dang du len pa'i mthu bral bas// thugs rje'i chu gter 'khrug par ma gyur cig /bstan 'dzin dbu 'phangs bstod pa'i sa skyong gi /mnga' ris phrag dog rtsed mo'i 'tshe bral bar// mang thos drang srong bde bar rgyu'o zhes// dkon mchog gsum mtshon rin chen rgyan 'di 'bul// ༈ //glo bo'i dpon po drung bkra shis mgon la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin brlabs kyis// g.yas ru gtsang gi sa yi ni// thig le yid 'ong nyams dga' ba// gser mdog can gyi skyed tshal nas// mang thos dge slong bsod snyoms pas// ri mor byas pa 'di springs so// lha sras skyi lde nyi ma mgon// de sras thu bo bkra shis mgon// pu hrangs glo dol gsum gyi mgon// gang de'i rnam sprul mnga' ris mgon// des pa 'tsho zhing thugs dge'am// phrag dog tsher ma rgyang srings sam// 'bangs rnams glo ba nyer gyur tam// dam can rgya mtsho nges bsrungs sam// gnas 'dir ring du 'khod gyur pas// 'dres shing bag phebs gyur pa yi// dzo gi rnal 'byor ldan pa 'di// gangs mtsho'i dngos grub len song ba// dro 'jam gos dang mchil lh+wam dang*// zhwa dang bza' btung sna tshogs dang*// yid 'ong lam rgyags mang po yis// 'dod pa'i gnas su bkri 'tshal lo// de yi legs byas rnga chen po// kun gyi rna bas len par shog/

༈ //glo bo'i dpon po drung a seng ba la gnang ba// ༄// sa ra swasti/ a mes rdo rje 'chang gi byin brlabs dang*// yum mchog rje btsun sgrol ma'i byams brtse dang*// dam can seng chen brgyad po'i mthu stobs kyis// mi dbang sa skyong rtag par zhabs brtan shig /dad pa'i zlos gar g.yo ba'i rtsed 'jo yis// lam ston bshes gnyen mang po bstan mkhas shing*// byams dang brtse bas mnga' 'bangs 'tsho ba dang*// dpa' mdzangs dpung gi dgra thabs bshams shes pa'i// lha sras mi dbang mthon po'i khrir bzhugs la// khrims ldan sdom brtson de yis zhe sa dang*// bla gos phrag par bgos te mchid 'di zhu// gang yang don gyi lang tsho ma nyams shing*// ldeb legs tshig gi skye mched mtshar ba yi// mi dbang thugs dgongs dag par mtshon nus pa'i// mchid 'phrin ngang pa'i bu mo gnas 'dir phebs// lo gsum bar du snyan grags mdangs gsal bar// 'tsho nus rin chen thig phreng ma nyams pas// sdom brtson gang gi ngur smrig mtshon byas nas// lhag bsam dag pas smon lam 'debs la brtson// nam yang bsod nams zas kyis 'tsho byed cing*// dman pa'i phyag dar gos la brten byas nas// dben pa'i nags su chos kyi tshig don la// rtog byed drang srong de yang 'di na dge /gong ma mtha' dag lha bzhin bkur ba dang*// 'og ma rnams ni bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// ring du 'gras pa'i dgra la'ang byams pa ni// chos su ma zad srid pa'i gzhung chen lags// dpung ldan dgra la dus min mi rgol zhing*// thub sla'i dgra bo thul nas skyong ba dang*// gna' dus mdza' po dgra bor mi len par// 'di gsum chos dang srid pa'i gzhung chen lags// phyi rol dgra bo zad zad bar du ni// btul bas thul ba srid pa gsum na med// thub chen rgyal ba de yis nang gi ni// dgra gcig choms pas phyi rol dgra kun zad// 'jig rten 'di na srog las phangs pa yi// dkor nor 'dzin pa'i lus can su yang med// gang gi de 'phrog byed pa gnag dka'i las// phyi ma rnam smin lci bar mkhyen lags mod// sku tshe 'dir yang lang tsho dar ba dang*// sku srog 'tsho ba'i dgra chen ma lags sam// byang chub thugs dang rig 'dzin sdom pa yang*// rtsub mo'i sbyor bas ring du gnas mi nus// gzhan gyis 'gran par mi nus dge ba'i tshogs// dpag med 'grub pa'i snyems pa'ang mdzad mi 'tshal// ji srid chos nyid mngon sum ma mdzad pa// de srid nag po'i las des de 'bras 'byin// yul phran dag na rgyal phran mang po zhig

/rang la ltos pa'i 'bangs kyi bde skyid ni// til mar bzhin du 'tshir zhing len pa mthong*// yul ljongs de na rgyal po'i bang mdzod gnas// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum mchod pa dang*// mnga' 'bangs rnams la brel phongs med pa dang*// 'phongs pa rnams la nar ma'i zas sbyor ba'i// bzang po'i srol de gong nas gong dag tu// rnam par spel la g.yel bar ma gyur cig /lha bsrungs mang po'i ri bos rgyab nas bskyor// bsod nams chu chen bzhi pos mdun nas bskor// rnam dpyod dpa' mdzangs gong nas gong brtsegs pa'i// pho brang mthon po'i rtse nas bsod nams kyi// rgyal rnga yang yang brdungs pa'i gzi byin gyis// pha rol dgra bo phrag dog tsher ma yis// rtsub mor byas pa'i lam chen de btang nas// chos dbyings zhi ba'i nags su song zhes grags// de nas dgra bo'i ngos bzung med pa yi// bshes su khas 'che de la bag phab nas// mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gang ba'i dga' ston myong*// bsod nams pho brang rtse nas legs byas kyi// rgyal rnga lan bdun brdungs pa'i zlos gar gyis// pha rol dgra bo phrag dog rdul rtsub can// chags sdang yul gyi dga' ba de bor nas// chos dbyings nags kyi mdzes ma la sred pas// 'od gsal ljon pa'i ngos la 'khril ba na// khrel yod nags kyi ma li gsar pa ni// rang nyid drang po'i gnas su go 'phangs bstod// snyan grags dzā ti'i me tog dkar po ni// thub rnams dgyes pa'i bzhad phreng gsar ba dang*// lhan cig bsod nams ljon pa rgyas pa yi// nags kyi sman ljongs mdzes pa e ma mtshar// ༈ //'phrang po dga' ldan phug gi chos mdzad ma chos sgron bzang mo la gnang ba// ༄// swasti/ khrims dang thos pa'i mdza' bos ma btang ba'i// bdag blo nam yang mya ngan med ma ni// thub rnams dgyes pa'i yid kyi mdza' bo dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur len to// de nas chos 'dod dpag bsam srid mo ni// don mthun yal 'dab rgyas pa'i ljon phreng rtser// gtong phod lugs brgya ldan pa'i me tog gi

/phreng mdzes 'dzin pa de yang dpyid kyi dpal// gang la 'dun pa'i yid kyi chu gter du// mi pham zhal gyi zla ba gsal 'gyur ba// de yi thugs rje bsil ba'i 'od dkar yang*// ku mud chu gter min pa gang du 'char// gang dag zang zing nor la mi lta zhing*// legs par bshad pa'i skyes la ngo mtshar ba// de yi mgul du rnar snyan gzung sla ba'i// yid 'ong chos kyi phreng ba 'di springs so// nges par chos la 'dun rnams kyis// dang por bya ba gang zhe na// nyes par spyad pa las bzlog pa'i// bsod nams bya ba de yin no// bar du bya ba ci zhe na// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis rab skyo bas// thar pa tshol ba gang yin pa// tha mar bya ba gang zhe na// stong pa nyid dang zung 'jug pa'i// snying rje bsgom pa de yin no// de la bsod nams gang zhe na// sbyin dang khrims dang bzod pa'o// nges 'byung thar pa gang zhe na// sdug bsngal spangs pa'i ye shes so// stong pa nyid blo gang zhe na// dngos po gang dang gang gi ni// rang bzhin tshol ba'i blo gros kyis// rnam par brtags na de de la// ngos bzung gang yang med pa'o// snying rje chen po gang zhe na// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro mang 'di// sdug bsngal rnams dang bral 'dod pa'o// chos kyi lha sras mched gsum po// 'phangs par 'dzin pa'i yum de ni// chos kyi sgron ma bzang po yis// rmongs pa'i mun las grol bar shog /ces 'di bsod snyoms zas kyis ni// 'tsho zhing phyag dar gos la ni// brten nas dben pa'i gnas su ni// chos kyi tshig don bzang po ni// 'dzin mkhas drang srong de yis ni// dbu ru stod kyi yul nas ni// ri mo'i skyes bu phul 'di ni// gang la 'dun pa'i snying gi ni// chu gter dbus su gnas byos shig /de nas rtag tu phan pa dang*// bde ba'i sbrang rtsi tshim gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni/ 'jam dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis 'phrang po dga' ldan phug gi chos mdzad ma la springs pa'o//

//maṅga laṃ bha wantu// //shubhaṃ// ༈ //bdag mo dpal sdings ma la chos la bskul ba'i gtam du gnang ba// ༄// na mo wa gi shwa ra ya/ mthong ba'i mod la dwang ba 'dren pa'i sku// thos ma thag tu nges shes ster ba'i gsung*// nges par bsams na phan pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rnam 'dren ston pa de yis khyod bsrungs shig /dal 'byor ljon phreng gsar pa'i dpag bsam la// sred pa'i 'khril shing mang pos nges 'khril nas// don med lo zla mang pos rnyings pa na// lang tsho'i lo 'dab 'dor ba mang yod kyang*// mkha' lding gis bskyungs bdud rtsi mang thungs nas// rang lus bdud rtsir byed pa'i rkang 'thung ni// brgya byin yul gyi yongs 'du ma gtogs pa// mi yul nags kyi ljon shing 'ga' ma mthong*/

bsod nams cha mthun gyi chos byed pa srid kyang*/ thar pa cha mthun gyi chos byed pa nyung ba'i shlau ka gcig dal 'byor gru chen srid pa'i brtod phur la// rtod byed gru mkhan 'khor ba'i chang gis ni// rnam par myos pa'i gru chen stong log mkhan// rang nyid blun por mtshon pa 'ga' med dam// nges 'byung gi blo bskyed pa'i ched du thog mar ston pa'i rnam thar dran par byas pa shlau ka gnyis/ 'jig rten 'di na 'khor los bsgyur ba yi// rgyal po'i dpal dang brgya byin phun tshogs la// yid rton med par thub chen des gzigs nas// ngur smrig gos dang bsod snyoms zas gsol te// byang chub shing drung dben pa der byon nas// 'od gsal stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// yid kyi srub shing 'dzin pa'i dpal bcom nas// byang chub bla na med pa de brnyes so// mgon thog mar dben pa la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam shlau ka gcig de'i rjes 'jug dul zhing btsun gyur ma// gcig pur yid kyi gdung ba bral byas nas// rnam dpyod tshul khrims mtshar ba'i mdza' bo dang*// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i rtse dga' lhur byos shig dben par bsdad nas thar pa don du gnyer dgos pa'i shlau ka gcig /'jig rten chos kyi sgyu ma'i nags khrod na// lang tsho'i spu sdug 'dzin pa'i khyu byug dag /srid bde'i snyan dbyangs sgrogs pa mang mod kyang*// nges 'byung dpag bsam 'dzin pa re re tsam// thog dben par rang sems la bltas na 'od gsal rtogs pa'i blo ngang gis 'byung ba'i shlau ka gsum/ med dus nas goms pa'i shugs drag gis// nyon mongs 'khrugs pa'i rba klong 'dren bzhin du// rtag par 'thur du 'bab pa'i ngang tshul can// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rang sems col chung po// dran dang shes bzhin mang po'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// gong nas gong du 'dren pa'i sgyu 'khrul mkhan// nyin mtshan 'da' ba'i rnal 'byor rnam gnyis kyi// dben pa'i gnas su rang sems 'dul 'grus na// sems nyid 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i zhal// gsal stong 'dzin med mtshar po'i skye mched can// lta byed yid 'ong ltad mo ngo mtshar ba// tshangs dang dbang pos byin 'dra myur du mthong*// tshe

rtag tu chos kyi phyag brgya bzhi la slob dgos pa la shlau ka gnyis/ 'di mi sdod sdod pa'i skabs med na// dam chos gang bya bya long yod med tsam// zag bcas mi bde bde bar 'dzin pa'i 'dug /sel byed skyabs 'gro 'gro ba'i sman gcig yin// chos kun rang stong stong pa'i tshul bslabs na// mtshan 'dzin ma lus lus pa med par 'jil// mya ngan 'das zhi zhi ba'i go 'phang yang*// yon tan kun rdzogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin// bla ma spyi bor bsgoms nas snying khar bzhugs su gsol bas dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung zhing sgrib pa ma lus pa 'dag pa'i dpe ston pa gsum/ gtong phod lugs rgya shes pa'i kha lo pas// gang drangs rin chen dkon mchog gsum ngo bo// dag byed khrus kyi gar mkhan ma de bzhin// thog mar khyod gtsug ral pa'i khur gyi long*// de nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i gdung shugs can// tsher tsher snyan pa'i skul byed zlos gar gyis// thugs rje che ldan drang srong dzā hu'i sras// rang sems ma dros rgya mtsho'i dpal du drongs// de nas yid kyi rnyog pa kun bkrus nas// legs byas khrus kyi chu chen bzhi po yis// pha mar gyur pa'i dal 'gro kun khrid nas// kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho 'dzin par nges// bstan bcos 'di'i lus mdor bsdus nas ngos gzung ba/ bag med mi rnams srid pa'i bde ba las// skul byed yid 'byung dben pa'i gtam dang ni// skabs gsum pa rnams rtse 'jo'i dga' ba las// slong byed chos kyi rnga chen bzhi po dang*// dkon mchog gsum dngos rdo rje 'dzin pa las// dngos grub rnam gnyis len pa'i skul byed mkhan// tshig don skye mched legs pa'i phrin yig 'di// gser mdog 'dzin pa'i nags khrod de nas phul// ma skul rang byon 'khyam po'i chos bshad kyi// lhang lhang mang po'i snyan dngags rol mo mkhan// don med gyi nar bor ba'i sgo drung du// la la'i rna bar mi sim sgrog ci 'tshal// blang dor dpyod pa'i rnam dpyod gsal ldan ma// rmongs rnams mgu dang mkhas rnams dgyes byed pa'i// rnam dbye phyed 'dra'i gsung gis bskul gyur pas// cung zad mi smra'i gdeng ma thob nas zhus// 'gro kun byams pa'i 'phang bar nyer blangs nas// nam yang thugs rje'i spyan gyis nyer 'tsho ba// yab gcig ston pa gshegs pa'i shul zhig na// mgon med kyi nar 'khyams pas yid skyo ba// lo zla mang po'i dmag gis rgyab nas ded// mthar byed pho nyas phyogs mtha' kun bskor yang*// da dung le lo'i gnyid kyis non bzhin du// smra mkhas legs pa'i blo yis 'di springs so//

༈ //gu ge bdag po blo bzang rab brtan pa la gnang ba// ༄// gru 'dzin chos kyi pho brang rtse mo nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i pho nya zhig /srong btsan mtshan mo'i nyi ma 'dir shar ba// brgyud par bcas la nges par rjes yi rang*// de'i rigs kyi thig le ma nyams pa// legs byas mtsho nas byed po'i lag pa yis// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan gnyis pa gzhan stsal ba// blo bzang utpal bzhad mdzad nyid drung du// gsung rab dpyod pa'i lce brgya ring rkyong yang*// che btsun smod pa'i lce rtse 'gugs byed pa// shākya'i sras kyi rjes 'jug klog pa bas// rje sar byas pa'i zhu mchid 'di springs so// lugs gnyis khur chen 'degs pa'i sa skyong gi /glang chen phal cher nub mtshor gshegs pa na// blo bzang rigs 'chol med pa sa bsrungs bu// rab brtan khyu mchog 'khrungs pa 'di na dge /bzang po'i cho ris mdzad pa ma nyams na// phya srid mar ngor gyur la snyengs mi 'tshal// rgyu skar mgon gcig mar ngo'i mthar thug nas// bsod nams cha shas gong nas gong der rtseg /sgrib kun bral ba'i thub chen nyi ma yang*// phrag dog lto rings rkyong ba'i drang srong ni// chags sdang 'khyog po'i lam du rtag rgyu bas// me dang mun pa'i 'khrul gyis za rtsom na// mthon pa'i dgung las nges par ma lhung zhing*// rnam dpyod 'od dkar nam yang ma 'gribs pa'i// sa skyong zla bar la las mtho 'tsham gyi// tsha zer zhags pas 'ching 'dod smos ci 'tshal// phyi nang zla gzhon gang ba'i lang tsho la// chags khro'i rdul gyis gnon 'dod mang mod kyi// bcu drug phyed phyed bcas pa'i bde chen yang*// dpe bral nyin mo'i zer dang lhan cig rgyu// de phyir gang la gnod pa'i las rnams kun// bdud rtsir mdzad pa'i blo gros bzang mnga' ba// gang khyod rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras gyur zhes// seng ge lta bur rab brtan srid na spyod// de skad mchid phrin ri mor phul ba'i rten// mkhas grub dam pa don yod dpal bzang pos// dpag bsam ljon phreng rgyas pa'i 'chi med bcud// lan brgyar gsol ba'i zhal dkar 'di 'bul lo// yar tshes bco lnga la gser mdog can nas phul ba'i zhu yig/

༈ //slar yang de nyid la gnang ba// ༄// kun sbyor 'ching ba brgya rgal pha rol na// lha gcig btsan po srid gsum gyi bla ma// ye shes 'od can bsil ba'i ri mthon pos// gangs can dge bar mtshon de phyag gi gnas// de las brgyud pa'i lugs gnyis chu klung gis// blo bzang gting mtha' yangs par ngal bso nas// ri rab lta bur brtan pa'i lhag bsam gyi// rin chen bang mdzod 'dzin pa nyid drung du// shākya'i sras kyi drang srong klog pa bas// bag yod bla gos phrag pa gcig bgyis nas// skabs kyi zhu mchid rol mor 'bul ba ni// lha sras zhal gyi mdun sa der bzhes shig /khri srong rigs kyi lang tsho ma nyams na// mnga' thang tshol ba'i 'grims 'grus mang mi 'tshal// legs byas kyis bskrun ri gling mtsho drug pos// ri dbang lhun por ngang gis 'dud cing 'dun// lhag bsam nor 'dzin 'phangs par stabs brtan na// phyi rol phrag dog zhags pa bsrung mi 'tshal// lhun stug brjid chags ri rab dbang po'i drung*// rta gdong 'bar ba'i gdung byed go skabs ci// lha sras rang 'gros drang zhing dal bar rgyu// gzhan stabs gya gyur byed pa myur ba'i 'gros// gang gi ngang tshul gzhan du g.yo min pa// nyi ma ji bzhin kun la snyoms de lags// gang gi rigs mchog ri rab ji bzhin du// ri gzhan mang pos kun nas bkur de ci// nang gi rnam dpyod rol mtsho ma 'khrugs shing*// rigs dang legs byas mthon por brtsegs des yin// nang gi dus sbyor log par mi rgyu zhing*// phyi rol dus sbyor 'chol bar mi 'gyur ba'i// mthun pa'i rkyen gang steng nas dkon mchog gsum// 'og nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi gdengs can dbang*// bar du 'jig rten skyong ba rnam bzhi dang*// sa skyong rgyal po dam pa'i chos bzhin du// bgyid mdzad de kun 'jig rten bde ba'i rgyu// de skad legs bshad me tog phreng mdzes ni// chos 'dod nags kyi dpag bsam dga' ma yi// yid kyi bzhin ras mdzes pa'i utpal phreng*// rnam grol ro brgya'i sbrang rtsi don gnyer ba'i// thar 'dod bung ba'i tshogs kyang 'di na rtse// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i me tog mda'// la la'i snying mtshor zhugs pa'i dgra thabs mkhan// phrag dog gru chen bzung nas 'dod pa yi// rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i byis pa 'ga' med dam// deng 'dir anda rnyil gyi chu gter du// smig rgyu lbu phreng 'dren 'dra'i sgyu ma la// sred pa'i zhags pas ma bcings ngang pa yis// khyu mchog ji bzhin chos kyi grwa na dge

/lha sras mchid phrin padmo'i phreng*// ngag gi skyed tshul las brgyud pa// bag med lag pas ma rnyings par// gang gi rna ba'i rgyan du phebs// de yi mchid phrin ma nyams pa'i// zhib zhus utpal phreng ba ni// sbyin pa'i 'od zer nyid las bzhes// thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo med pa// kun tu 'khrug par ma gyur cig /bzang po'i tshes la zhus pa'o// ༈ //gu ge mnga' bdag pa gtsang du byon nas log 'byon kha bsam 'grub rtse na bzhugs pa la gnang ba// ༄// lha mnga' bdag gi drung du zhu ba/ shākya'i sras kyi klog pa pa/ lha nyid zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mjal ba la rngo thog par ma gyur pa'i skabs nyid nas/ zhu 'phrin gsol ba ni/ nyin mor byed pa sa skyong bzhin// kun la snyoms shing ngang gis 'char// lha sras mnga' bdag nyi ma ltar// mthon po'i dgung las lhung mi mnga'// char chen khur khyer sprin stug po// gzhan la phan mdzad rgyal po bzhin// mnga' bdag sprin gyi bu mo ltar// dregs can ri brgya'i rtse gnon zhing*// phongs pa'i gshongs bu dma' bar yang*// thugs rje'i rgyun chen rigs par 'bebs// yang 'di skad ces/ spyi mthun legs byas gya gyur byed pa na// yul gru'i phrag dog tshad pa la byol nas// rtsang phyogs bsil ba'i dpag bsam ljon phreng rtser// ma rmongs chos kyi 'gyur khugs stong ldan khyod// blta 'dod mang po'i re ba 'dir bkang nas// sa skyong nyi ma ba glang spyod gling gi /shar phyogs zhang zhung 'dab brgya'i tshal ngogs su// glang chen stabs kyis dul bar skyod lags sam// de nas me dang mun pa'i lam dag tu// nam yang mi 'jug phyogs kun bde bar shog /gang phyir brtul phod mdzad pa'i don de yang*// slu med dkon mchog gsum gyis der stsol shig /ces shis brjod kyi me tog brda' mtshon 'bul ba la/ bshes gnyen nam mkha'i rin chen thegs pa lags/ cho 'phrul can gyi yar tshes la zhu yig/

༈ //dbus nas phebs/ rin spungs nang so shākya rgyal mtshan pa nor bu khyung rtser bzhugs dus su gnang ba// ༄// dpal ldan mi dbang sa chen gsum gyi bdag /srid zhi'i dbang phyug nyams pa med de'i drung*// shākya'i sras kyi rjes 'jug klog pa pa// byang shar nyi ma'i lam nas gegs med par// rmongs bral mun pa'i gnyen dang chab gcig par// gser mdog chos kyi mdangs can 'dir 'ongs te// khyung tshang shar gyi ri bo'i phrag pa nas// khyung rtse nor bu'i pho brang 'pho med par// mchid shog kun la snyoms pa'i phyag ring po// rkyong mdzad yangs pa'i mdun sar phul te mchis// gang sku 'khor lo rnam drug dam tshig par// zung 'jug bde chen ye shes de byon nas// g.yo med bcu drug phyed phyed dga' ba yis// nges par 'tsho byed slar yang rgyal gyur cig /nam zhig dpung tshogs rlabs kyi phreng gnyer ba// pha rol chu srin gdangs pa'i khar song zhes// rang phyogs gru chen 'dzin pa'i skye bo phal// snyom las le lo'i mal nas mi ldang mod// las chen gyis 'phangs shugs ldan sgra brgya pa// mthar byed mche ba'i lam du 'khyams pa na// lto ba'i khyim chen bshig pa'i drag shul gyi// thun mtshams gos dmar chu gter khang bzang 'dzin// bstan jus lam du 'dren pa'i skya ba mkhan// dpa' mdzangs 'grus ldan kha lo pas bsrungs pa// 'jig rten gzhung shing drang por nges tshugs pa'i// phya srid rta gdong mgrin pa mthor theg shig /gzung 'dzin lam du rgyu ba'i dgra thabs mkhan// 'pho chen bcu gnyis g.yo ba'i gya gyu can// rang gnas btang nas dbu ma'i khang bzangs su// 'jug mkhas rigs ldan drag por khyod gyur cig /bka' mchid ri mo 'bul ba'i rten stengs su// brgya byin dgra bos ma myangs rgya mtsho'i bcud// dpag bsam ljon phreng rgyas pa'i rtser 'ongs pa// ras dkar phur ma'i ngos su rgyas btab 'bul// mar ngo bral ba'i phya srid yar gyi tshes// cha shas rdzogs pa'i 'od dkar ma nyams shing*// bcu drug cha shas nyams pa mi mnga' zhes// mtshon byed bzang po'i nyin la zhus pa 'di// phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dge mtshan lags//

༈ //pu hrangs mkhan po la gnang ba// ༄// sde snod 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes// yin lugs byed pa'i shes rab dang*// tshul khrims rnam gsum goms mdzad pa// gang khyod 'dun pas nyer 'phangs pa'i// 'dod bya'i gnas su gegs med par// nye bar son nas bde'o zhes// 'phros pa'i gtam gyi zegs phreng yangs// rna ba'i utpal gyis mthungs shing*// grags pa min pa'i tsha zer gyis// yid kyi ku mud rnyings pa med// lam stegs sa skyong pho brang nas// mchid phrin shog bur ma bris kyang*// yid kyi ri mo ma nyams pa'i// skyes phreng bzed zhal bdun phrag ni// phyag rgyas bcings pa 'dir 'ongs so// gzhan phan lhag bsam ma nyams shing*// phrag dog tsher mas mi 'tshe ba'i// bskal bzang nags kyi sman ljongs su// legs bshad rma bya'i gdugs mdzes kyi// zlos gar g.yo byed byis pa rnams// gang du mching ba'i nor bral yang*// shes rab tshul khrims nor mang pos// phyug po'i go 'phangs brnyes par mdzod// dge 'dun mchog grub glo bo nas// phyir ldog byed dang pu hrangs su// 'gro zhes the tshom drwa ba yis// bcings phyir yi ger rten ma bskur// byis rnams mgu byed 'jig rten gzhung*// gya gyur byed rnams mi ldan yang*// 'tshe med bden gtam 'ba' zhig pa// bsrung mdzad 'jig rten mkhyen pa zhes// legs bshad ri mo ma nyams pa// skyes su phul ba 'di yin no// zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la phul// ༈ //bsod snyoms pa'i spyi 'gro// ༄// nyi ma shar phyogs kyi sbyin pa'i bdag po rnam pa'i bsod nams kyi sgo drung du/ gser mdog can gyi chos kyi 'dun sa nas/ thub pa'i dbang po'i brtul zhugs dri ma med pa la nye bar gnas pa'i dge 'dun/ bsod snyoms pa grwa chen du longs pa dag spyod yul gyi grongs so sor bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhud pa/ sngon bzhin ji ltar 'tsham pa'i rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i rim pa thugs la 'dogs 'tshal/

tshes bcu la phul// ༈ //sa skyong don yod rdo rje dpung gi thog tu phebs nas gzhis ka sne'u phyogs su bskyod skabs shis brjod du gnang ba// ༄// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ don yod dbang po'i rdo rje nyi ma bzhin// rang 'gros gshegs stabs shar du bskyod pa'i tshe// me dang mun pa'i lam du mi gzigs par// dus sbyor bde ba'i khyim gyi rgyal por spyon// sa skyong bde chen gser gyi 'khor lo bsgyur// bsod nams rgyas pa'i las sbyor mkhan gang de// rang srid khri la g.yo ba med bzhin du// gzhan srid dpal 'byor mang pos mdun nas bsu// mi dbang ye shes dngul dkar 'khor lo'i bdag /sdig dang sdug bsngal zhi ba'i sgyu rtsal mkhan// 'tshe med bde ba'i lam du gshegs tsam gyis// pha rol mi bsrun phrag dog dbyings su zhi// srid la dbang byed zangs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur// chos kun dbang du bsdud pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// dpung tshogs rnam bzhi'i bkod pa bshams tsam na// phyogs gzhan yul ngor gzims pa'i rgyal thabs mkhan// sa bdag dregs ldan lcags kyi 'khor lo bsgyur// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag po'i snyems can de// byams pa'i gnam ru gyen du bslang byas nas// snying rje'i nyag phran stong gi sbyor ba shes// de ltar zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi// las sbyor rnam bzhis phyug pa'i nor 'dzin ni// dpal ldan phag gru'i phya srid lhun po'i dpal// gyen du 'degs pa'i bkra shis deng 'dir spyon// zhes pa hor zla lnga pa yi// yar tshes gcig la gser mdog can// sde snod klog pa'i chos grwa nas// rgyal dang shis par brjod pa lags// //maṅga laṃ// //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //bya pa chos rje skal bzang pas mdzad pa 'khrul med brtsams nas gzigs 'bul gyi zhu yig lan du gnang ba// ༄// na maḥswa ra swa st+yai/ 'jig rten 'di na yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// mang pos bskur ba'i rigs gyur shākya'i sras// nyi ma'i gnyen zhes grags pa'i gdugs dkar gyis// sa gsum khebs mdzad de la mgos phyag 'tshal// mkhas rmongs mtha' dag ngo mtshar dad pa yi// yid 'ong shing rta 'dren pa'i kha lo pa// kun las mchog gyur 'khrul med mdzad pa ni// ston pa bas kyang mchog tu bsngags bya'i yul// ston pa'i thugs las gzhan du ma 'phos pa'i// ya mtshan mdzad pa'i ri mo ma nyams pa// gang blo dngul dkar dwangs pa'i me long la// gsal bar 'phos gyur de yang ston pa bzhin// rigs pa'i gnas las mi 'chad yod min pa// rig byed dran pos 'di bshad ma nus shing*// phyi nang kun gyi byed por khas blangs pa'i// gser gyi mngal ldan des kyang 'di ma sprul// sngon rabs mkhas pa'i thugs la byon gyur kyang*// don mang tshig nyung rjod byed sgrig legs pa// brjod bya'i don rnams yid ches mdo lung bzhin// gsal bar smra byed gzhan du 'ga' ma mthong*// bdag blo'i brjed ngas mun pa sel ba dang*// gzhan blo rmongs pa'i tsha gdung gzhil pa dang*// phal cher dwang ba 'dren pa'i dge mtshan can// rnam thar kun gsal padma'i gdong mtshar ba// de yi ya mtshan ma tshang med de kun// rnyog bral dwangs pa'i blo mtshor gsal ba ni// skal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho ma gtogs pa// gnyis pa gzhan zhig deng sang yod ma yin//

//e ma 'khrul med mdzad pa'i che ba rang brtsom byed po'i grags pa spro mkhas khengs ldan gzhan gyi dregs pa gzhom byed don mang chos kyi rgya mtshor mtshon nus tshig legs brda' dag brjod pa kun bde smra mkhas smra ba'i dbang por 'dis mtshon nyi ma bzhin du rmongs pa sel byed zla ba lta bur dga' ba skyed mkhas rgyu skar dang mtshungs bstan pa'i rgyan gyur dpyod ldan tshogs pa'i dbus su brim bya gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams la bstab 'os rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod pa bla med mkhas 'dod ring nas 'gugs pa'i pho nya chos 'dod rnams la sbyin pa'i mchog gyur thub bstan lhun po 'degs pa'i sa gzhi dam chos dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho lan cig thos pas rna ba'i dpal bskyed lan 'ga' bsams pas bstan la yid ches mngon par mtho ba'i them skas mchog gyur nges par legs pa'i sgo chen gsum phye bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan bzang 'di mthong de nas de la rab tu dwang bas byang chub sems dpa'i smon mchog de skyes srid mtha'i sngon gyi mdzad pa bsams pas byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong de grub 'khrul med mdzad pa'i glegs bam sbyar ba'i dpal yon dag ni de de kho nar ma zad de sbyor byed pa'i rgyas sras de yang sngon chad dus 'dir srid zhi'i dbang phyug nyid du don la gnas kyang ka la pa zhes mtshan tsam grags pa'i don gang ji bzhin 'phags yul dang 'dra'i ljongs 'dir byon pa'i mkhas rmongs kun gyi yid dang rna ba'i lam du gang gi gnas tshul byang bar gyur pa yin mod pad dkar 'dzin pa'i dpal des dri med 'od phreng 'dzin pa'i bstan bcos sbyar ba dang mtshungs ngo mtshar 'khrul med mdzad pa'i bstan bcos nye bar sbyar 'di bskal bzang chos kyi yid bzhin mtsho dang rnam dkar gangs kyi ri bo dang ni phrin las grong rdal dgu bcu drug gi yon tan ma lus gsal bar byas so de nyid mkhas dang gzu bos lta ci smos dang gzu bo min pas kyang ni yi rangs mgo bo dud par bkug nas gus pa'i thal mo snying khar sbyar zhing snyan pa'i tshig bcad utpal phreng mdzes nyin dang nyin la lan cig min par 'dogs byed de yi dge ba khyod kyis sems can kun la 'phangs pa med par byin pa de yang de ring 'di na shākya'i sras kyi rjes 'jug klog pa pa ni 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas mthun pa'i dbyangs gcig gis ni blu med dkon mchog gsum la mchod par 'bul lo bskal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho 'gro la ring du gnas nas bshad sgrub bstan pa rin chen mang po nam yang mi btong rtag tu 'dzin pa'i dpal gyur cig/

//'dir smras pa/ nges pa'i don du rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsum mdzad pa dang bcas pa// chos dbyings ye shes gcig nyid la// gzhan du cung zad 'phos pa med// drang ba'i don du gzhan blo la// gang shar snang mkhan rang sems sam// de las gzhan du med ces pa'i// lugs gnyis deng sang so sor smra// sa bkar rnying gsum bstan pa la// gus par mdzad nas sems can dang*// sangs rgyas la yang gang snang ba// snang bo'i sems las gzhan du med// 'o na sangs rgyas sems can dang*// de yang sangs rgyas su 'gyur te// de dag la de snang phyir ro// zhe na nyes pa yod min te// rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob kyi// snang ba 'char pa min phyir dang*// sa bcu po la'ang sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan ji snyed mi snang phyir// rang re'i ston pas sngon dus su// zhing sbyangs pa dang sems can rnams// smin par mdzad nas 'dzam gling du// 'pho ba'i dus la bab gyur tshe// smin pa'i sems can blo gros kyi// me long thob pa de dag rnams// bzhin 'phags pa'i yul du 'khrungs// ngo mtshar mdzad pa bgrang yang shar// de yang snang mkhan rang sems dang*// yongs su ma smin sems can la// mya ngan 'das par gang snang ba// de yang rang gi sems nyid de// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rang snang la// mya ngan 'da' ba lta ci smos// 'pho dang lhums su zhugs pa yang*// ji bzhin min pa nyid phyir ro// rdzogs sangs rgyas la mi snang na// kun rdzob chad par 'gyur zhes smra// gdod nas yod ma myong ba la// chad pa'i ming 'dogs su yis byed// gnyis snang bag chags ma spangs pa// de srid kun tu snang ba 'char// de yi ring la bsod nams kyi// tshogs rdzogs gyur nas sangs rgyas pa// don dam chos sku nyag gcig po// sems can blo la mi snang yang*// bsod nams tshogs dang smon lam gyi// dbang gis sprul sku rgyun mi chad// zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rigs rus cho 'brang gi dpal gyis mngon pa mtho zhing mang du gsan pa rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs pa/ rgyal ba'i sras po bskal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i sdes/ mdzad pa 'khrul med kyi bstan bcos chen po'i brtsom pa par du grub pa'i glegs bam/ thub bstan gser mdog can zhes bya ba sde snod klog pa'i grwa chen por springs pa'i mchid lan du gsol ba/ 'khrul med mdzad pa rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos nye bar sbyar nas phul ba yin no// //maṅga laṃ// //bha wantu shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
